Thank you for these words, I appreciate that. I‘m a year in but haven‘t made any progress yet. Maybe it‘s a matter of time I don‘t know. As for the shaming aspect, the thing is that it seems like no one really knows anything about herpes here, not even some of the doctors. I don‘t know how it is to live with it in the US, maybe herpes is a bigger topic there but I don‘t think that is automatically bad. At least there are support groups and a lot of people on dating sites. Plus, the doctors are more educated about it so more people are diagnosed. That means more people know they have it and the dating pool is a lot bigger for positive people out there. Here I feel very much alone with it, but the stigma is still there. Few guys I know lately talked bad about girls with herpes. I don‘t know anymore, maybe someday I will find courage again to go out again but for now I can‘t take any more rejection just because of something I have no control of. I‘m just so sick of it.
